43 weeks = 43 × 7 = 301 days.  
Add 6 days → total 307 days.  
1894 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1894 not divisible by 4).  
From 1894-04-10 add 307 days:  
April: 20 days left (30–10) → 20 days used, 287 left.  
May (31) → 287–31=256 left.  
June (30) → 256–30=226 left.  
July (31) → 226–31=195 left.  
August (31) → 195–31=164 left.  
September (30) → 164–30=134 left.  
October (31) → 134–31=103 left.  
November (30) → 103–30=73 left.  
December (31) → 73–31=42 left.  
January 1895 (31) → 42–31=11 left.  
February 1895 (28, not leap) → 11–28 = –17 → means into March: February has 28 days, so after Feb 28, 11 days remain → March 11.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1895-03-11
